expectations.evidence: The transcript gives one complete charter (Professional lab exam plus Founding Expert route, full Expert exam at about month 14). It mentions alternatives only as rejected rungs (multiple-choice exam, day-one Expert exam, full proctored certification) and adds an 'If the CEO insists' fallback. These are never offered as ranked candidate designs to choose from. The closing 'What I need from you' asks for budget, learner location, and CEO confirmation, but it does not ask the user to pick a design. The design is already chosen and fully worked out.
